s: The service Centre is on the western side of the interchange, with both north and south-bound traffic able to access it from the western roundabout. t: Taupiri - Wikipedia
s: December 24, 2025 - In early years it was the headquarters of Ngāti Mahuta. Te Putu built Taupiri pā on the summit of a spur of Taupiri mountain, in the 17th century. When Te Putu was killed, he was buried at the pā, which thus became tapu (sacred) and was abandoned. Early European travellers in the area were obliged by Māori to cross to the other side of the Waikato River to avoid the sacred area.
